entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: internal invariant: ast.Parse rejects at validation every scalar filter whose left operand is not a single aggregate or whose right operand is not a single literal (validateScalarFilterStage in internal/traceql/ast/validate.go), so lowerSimpleScalarFilter only ever calls lowerScalarExpr with an ast.Aggregate or an ast.Static — the default arm is unreachable at this call site.

guard: past exhaustive switch v := e.(type) over [case traceql.Aggregate; case *traceql.Aggregate; case traceql.Static; case *traceql.Static]
